veranderings.voor: 'n Motor binne-in laat sy wiele draai.
veranderings.na: 'n Motor binne-in laat die wiele draai.
veranderings.rede: 'sy' can be read as the motor's wheels rather than the toy car's; 'die' removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.

veranderings.voor: wanneer dit nodig is en ook net dan
veranderings.na: wanneer dit nodig is en net dan
veranderings.rede: 'ook' is redundant before 'net dan' and makes the phrase wooden; 'en net dan' is the natural idiom.

vlae.teks: In 'n stelsel is dit die deel wat beheer.
vlae.rede: 'beheer' is left without an object, so the sentence feels unfinished; supplying one (what it controls) would mean choosing content, so the writer should decide.
The block heading is phrased as a question but has no question mark; headings cannot be changed by the language step, so the writer should decide whether to punctuate or rephrase it.
